title: Control for c40's dividing CIPS condensates: the division survives an isotropic discretization. With the enzyme drift computed by spectral derivatives instead of the MUSCL face flux, bodies still elongate into dumbbells and pinch (9 persistent splits, generation 2, 0 merges on seed 1 from the random field); only the division axis changes, from one locked diagonal to all orientations
summary: In my review of 20261026T1025-c40-cips-turnover-divide-claim every dumbbell, at 192^2 and in c40's Lsc=5 run, elongated along the same diagonal, so the grid could be selecting or even causing the elongation. world_iso.py is c40's world.py with one option: ISO=1 replaces vf_flux_div (dimension-split MUSCL upwind face flux of chi e(1-e) grad p) by spectral derivatives of the same flux (iso_flux_div); ISO=0 is c40's world. Planted founder plus the default random field (plant_r=6, seed 0, t=8000): ISO=0 gives 6 persistent splits, every dumbbell on the same diagonal (planted_iso0/sheet.png); ISO=1 gives 6 persistent splits, 0 merges, with dumbbells vertical, horizontal and on both diagonals (planted_iso1/sheet.png). From the claim's own random-field start (ISO=1, seed 1, t=12000): 8 nucleations, 9 persistent splits, generation 2, 0 merges, 18 bodies, dumbbells at many angles (noise_iso1/seed1/sheet.png); c40's MUSCL pack on seed 1 has 9 persistent splits, generation 2 by t=20000. So the grid sets the axis, not the division.

finding.operator: fuel-limited cooperative CIPS with enzyme turnover (c40), enzyme drift discretized isotropically
finding.control: same world with the original MUSCL face flux (ISO=0), same planted founder and seed
finding.result: ISO=1: 6 persistent splits (planted, seed 0, t=8000) and 9 persistent splits, generation 2, 0 merges (random field, seed 1, t=12000), dumbbells at all orientations; ISO=0: 6 persistent splits, all on one diagonal

limitations: Spectral derivatives of a sharp-ish nonlinear flux are not positivity-preserving; e is clipped to [0, 1] inside the mobility only, and I saw no blow-up to t=12000. Two runs with ISO=1; the fuel fork was not repeated with ISO=1. The finding supports D in the claim and the C:metabolic-cell route; it says nothing new about E.
